Synopsis

Awakening is the dream of many—Riches, fame, knowledge, and power, by climbing the tower you can earn it all!

But I...Don't particularly care about any of that?

Why did I awaken? And why did my gender change?

Alchemist? Gallery?

It seems I've awakened. As a cute girl nonetheless. Guess I'll climb the tower and make potions.

...Why is this kind of fun?

Honestly, It's way too heckin' cute. It's got all the best fluff with an actually funny MC, a great supporting cast with the other Alchemists and Forums, and a best friend ;) with an actual personality. No huge drama, cute moments, character building and just enough tension to keep you invested. Honestly, the very embodiment of what I've always wanted from the niche combination of a Modern Fantasy, Progression based, Cozy, Slice of Life, Light Romance, Gender-Swap story with some genuinely heartfelt moments. All in all, reading this has me sitting with a smile on my face the way very few things do. I highly recommend you check it out if even a single thing I've mentioned appeals to you.

    New SunSol
    Status: chapter 104 – styles of alchemy
    Sep 3, 2026

    5 out of 5 stars. I binged the story over 4 day upto chapter 104 as I couldn't put it down. An amazing slice of life story with an interesting modern world fantasy touch. It is not often you see such well MC with a personality that feels real. It is a laid back daily life story so don't expect constant action. Warning that there is a very slow burn romance between girls. I know some people hate romance that drags, but it feels very real in that fumbling young college age romance way. Don't expect hot and heavy. My only honest complaint is I ran out of story and I can't wait to see where this is going.

    I love this read! I've blitzed its entirety (C102 at time of writing) over the past day or so and Stella is in contention for one of my favorite protagonists ever. All of the named characters are well written, the humor is funny (in a very internet-style way), and the story stays true to itself as a slice of life (though there are sprinklings of action (which are awesome)) ! The main relationship is also so cute it's squeal-worthy. Easy 5/5 (Would be 6/5 if we got the bouncy ball video XD).

    SuperSapphicSydney
    Status: chapter 36 – steel gators vs principality...
    Jun 25, 2026

    Wow, this was a fun read! I binged this in a few hours and it was a delight to read. Stella/Bin/Raccoon is hilarious and I just love her to pieces. The worldbuilding is unique and interesting. Not sure I've seen a tower based system set up quite like this before. I really enjoy some of the jumps in POV as they show the world reacting to Raccoon's antics and give you more scope of the net slowly closing around her oblivious ass. Luna/Mouse is a sweetheart of a LI and I'm excited by how things are developing. Though I'd love for less ambiguity and more outright affection. The gallery interactions are some of my favorite parts. She's a troll, but for the LOLs and not the hate which is a breath of fresh air. My only complaint has been the formatting. It's a little janky and needs a good edit, but overall the story is solid and fun to read. I look forward to more chapters!
